newsitem.title: USA: National Energy acquires Louisiana field.
newsitem.headline: National Energy acquires Louisiana field.

text.p: National Energy Group Inc said Monday it has completed the acquisition of Bayou Sorrel Field from Panaco Inc.
Earlier the company said it would pay $9 million for the properties are located in Bayou Sorrel in Iberville Parish, La., adjacent to its C.E. Schwing No. 1 discovery well.
National Energy also said it purchased of an additional 14 percent working interest in the C.E. Schwing for undisclosed terms, raising its interest to about 31 percent.
The company said it plans increased development and exploration operations in the area, adding it plans to make this area of southern Louisiana a major focus area .
National Energy said it plans to shoot a 33 square mile 3-D seismic survey in the area.
